description: AstroFlux is a team of B.Tech IT students passionate about space, AI, data, and innovation. We transform NASA’s open data into creative, practical solutions through technology, teamwork, and problem-solving.
summary:
**PrithviEcho – Listen to the Universe. Hear the Earth.**

PrithviEcho is an interactive Earth-information experience inspired by NASA's Earth Information Jukebox challenge. The project aims to transform complex Earth observation and satellite data into an engaging and accessible experience, helping people better understand our planet through technology and creative visualization.

By connecting Earth science with interactive digital experiences, PrithviEcho seeks to make scientific information easier to explore, interpret, and appreciate. It bridges the gap between complex scientific datasets and everyday users, encouraging curiosity about Earth's changing environmental systems.

The project highlights the importance of making NASA's open Earth science data more accessible, understandable, and engaging, empowering students, researchers, and the public to explore our planet in new ways.
details:
PrithviEcho – Listen to the Universe. Hear the Earth.

PrithviEcho is an interactive Earth-information platform developed by Team AstroFlux to make Earth observation and environmental information more accessible, understandable, and engaging.

What does it do and how does it work?

PrithviEcho aims to transform complex Earth science information into an accessible digital experience. It connects the concept of Earth observation with interactive technology, helping users explore and understand our planet and its changing environmental conditions.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project encourages awareness of Earth's environmental systems and makes scientific information easier for students, researchers, and the general public to explore. Its intended impact is to promote scientific curiosity, environmental awareness, and wider engagement with NASA's Earth science resources.

Technologies Used

The development approach uses modern web technologies, including TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Node.js, and Vite. The project also incorporates backend development and database technologies, with MongoDB used for data management. AI integration is explored through Google's Gemini API.

Creativity and Innovation

PrithviEcho combines Earth science, digital interaction, and modern technology into a unified experience. Its creative approach focuses on making scientific exploration more engaging rather than presenting Earth information only as conventional text and statistics.

Factors Considered

Our team considered accessibility, usability, scientific relevance, data understanding, technological feasibility, and the importance of communicating environmental information clearly. We aim to make Earth science more approachable and inspire people to understand and protect our planet.
